program.title: Leafy Creations
program.description: Transform ordinary leaves into extraordinary art pieces through traditional eco-friendly crafting techniques. Connect with nature's beauty while developing creativity and environmental awareness through hands-on leaf art activities.
program.imageAlt: Beautiful leaf art creations by children

items.title: Nature's Treasure Hunt
items.description: Explore the courtyard to collect leaves of different shapes, sizes, and textures while learning about various trees and plants.

items.title: Leaf Pressing & Preservation
items.description: Learn traditional techniques to preserve leaves, create pressed leaf collections, and understand the science behind plant preservation.

items.title: Artistic Leaf Collages
items.description: Create stunning artwork using leaves as natural paintbrushes, stamps, and collage materials for unique artistic expressions.

items.title: Eco-Awareness Circle
items.description: Discover the importance of leaves in our ecosystem, learn about photosynthesis, and discuss how to care for our environment.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Old clothes, collecting basket, water bottle

items.label: Take home
items.value: Pressed leaf collection, leaf art masterpieces, nature journal
